title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Comparing Years (Year-Over-Year) in Analysis Mode: A Simple 4-Step Guide
summary: This post explains how to create year-over-year comparison reports in Business Central using Analysis Mode, a feature that enables pivot table creation and data analysis directly on list pages without requiring separate reporting or customization. The post walks through a four-step process using General Ledger Entries as an example and covers feature evolution from BC22 through BC26.
key_points: Analysis Mode allows users to create pivot tables and analysis views on list pages without customization or separate report running
Year-over-year analysis compares current year data against same periods in previous years to evaluate metrics over time
The four-step process involves enabling Pivot Mode, setting display values, dragging the Posting Date Year to column labels, and grouping rows
Analysis results can be shared via copy link or exported to Excel, and Copilot can assist with creating analysis tabs
features: Related table fields in analysis mode

quotes.text: Comparing Years report (Year-Over-Year or YoY Analysis) simply means comparing year-over-year or year-on-year data.
